Select assay_chembl_id, target_type, tax_id, canonical_smiles, molecule_chembl_id, standard_type, and pchembl_value. Join molecule_dictionary to activities on molregno, activities to assays on assay_id, and assays to target_dictionary on tid. Join compound_structures on molregno as an inner join. Filter by target chembl_id CHEMBL3892, standard_type IC50, standard_relation equals, and pchembl_value not null. Sort by molecule_chembl_id then assay_chembl_id. Limit to 1000 rows.
